fix: Explicit tsconfigRaw with empty compilerOptions prevents ambient TypeScript strict-mode metadata discovery during JavaScript-only bundling. Emitted ESM remains inherently strict.
priorFailure: An otherwise identical rebuild intermittently added one redundant use strict directive to an ESM module initializer.
